description: Directory of A-share ETFs: manager, tracked index, tick size, daily limit band. Filter by `index_code` (`000300` or `SSE:000300`), `q` (name/ticker substring) or `asset_class`. For a fund's own numbers use `etf_show`. ⚠️ `asset_class` is only published for Shenzhen-listed funds — filtering by it drops every Shanghai one. ⚠️ `limit_pct` null = band unknown, not unbanded. `price_tick` is 0.001 (a tenth of the stock tick).

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

asset_class.description: Shenzhen-only classification; drops all Shanghai funds when set

index_code.description: Tracked index code, bare ('000300') or prefixed ('SSE:000300')

q.description: Substring over Chinese name and ticker

name: etf_list
